statements.quote: We expect capital expenditures to increase in coming years to support growth in our cloud offerings and our investments in AI infrastructure and training.
statements.notes: Names AI infrastructure and training as a driver of the expected increase in total capex, alongside cloud growth. It gives no amount and no specific year ('coming years').

statements.quote: The investments we are making in cloud and AI infrastructure and devices will continue to increase our operating costs and may decrease our operating margins.
statements.notes: Ties expected increases in total operating costs to cloud, AI infrastructure and devices investments together. The AI share is not separated. Forward-looking ('will continue to increase'), with no year named.
